newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel to study new Thomson-CSF plans.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel to study new Thomson-CSF plans.

text.p: French engineering firm Alcatel Alsthom on Friday said it would study the government's new proposals on the future of defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF.
Earlier, French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin said he was ending Thomson-CSF's privatisation process.
"We will study the new modalities set by the government," a company spokesman told Reuters.
He refused further comment, except to say that Alcatel remained interested in playing a central role in the restructuring of France's defence industry.

The French government said on Friday it had decided to halt Thomson-CSF's privatisation and would propose an alternative solution to build "a French professional and defence electronics pillar" based on the company.
Jospin's office said in a statement that the government would retain a stake that gave it ultimate decision-making power.
